messages.content:
Dear ViBe Support Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to raise a concern regarding my course completion status on the ViBe platform.

Although I have completed the entire course — including attending all lectures, watching all videos (including the final two slots), attempting and completing all quizzes, and making notes throughout — my dashboard is still showing **97.61% completion** instead of 100%.

From the completion details:

* Total Completed: 982 / 1006
* Videos Watched: 394 / 517
* Quizzes Completed: 487 / 489
* Express Section: Showing 134/134 
* React Section: 316/369 completed

However, I have already watched all the videos till the last lecture. The Express section also reflects full completion visually, yet the count appears inconsistent. This indicates a possible backend progress-tracking issue.

At this stage, it is extremely difficult for me to manually scroll and re-open hundreds of videos to identify which specific ones are contributing to the completion percentage. I have already spent nearly 5–6 hours trying to resolve this by replaying some lectures, but the progress percentage does not increase.

I have attached screenshots as proof of my current completion status.

I kindly request the following:

1. Please review my backend progress logs and verify my completion manually.
2. Kindly update my course completion status to 100% after verification.
3. Ensure that my Health Points (HPs) are not deducted due to this technical issue, as the incomplete status is not due to lack of effort on my end.

I have carefully reviewed the FAQs and discussion threads, but my situation appears different because replaying lectures is not affecting the progress count.

I sincerely request your assistance in resolving this at the earliest, as I have fully completed the course and fulfilled all requirements.

Thank you for your time and support.

Regards,
Manish Kumar
